title: C — #9 toolbar arrangement moved to its own file
paragraphs: The code that decides which six circles sit in the footer row, what lives behind the ▲ drawer, and how a drag reorders them has moved out of the 3,400-line editor file into useToolbarSlots.ts. This is seam 1 of the editor split.
Circles, the ▲ drawer and the Alt+1…6 hotkeys must behave exactly as before.
checks: Drag a circle to a new position. The order sticks after reload.
Open ▲ and drag a drawer entry onto a row slot. They swap.
Hold Alt: each circle shows its number. Alt+1 opens the first circle's panel.
Open S (style) then R (review). Only one row is open at a time.
